title: The cost of tourism in Kazakhstan
content:
Cheap and picturesque tourist destinations are always the best places for vacations. If you want to enjoy the wide steppes of the Altai Mountains or the enchanting lakes, let me tell you that your next step is to calculate... The cost of tourism in Kazakhstan To see if Is Kazakhstan cheap or expensive? Is it a wonderful place that deserves to be your next destination? Below I will answer you in detail your questions about life in Kazakhstan and how much does a trip to Kazakhstan cost? What is the best time to visit Kazakhstan? And more details, follow me. If Kazakhstan is compared to other similar tourist destinations, we can say that it does not cost much, because you will not exceed $900 if your stay is longer than 10 days, taking into account that this price includes Trips Flight, accommodation, transportation and other tourism activities. But in general, there is no specific amount that can be approved because the cost of travel depends on each individual’s style of expenses, but when compared with the local Kazakh currency, we see that about 1 dollar = 475 Kazakh tenge, and this means that 900 dollars will guarantee you the luxury of life in Kazakhstan with a lot of pleasure.
If the amazing nature, cultural dimension, and modern urbanization are the most important factors that attract tourists to Kazakhstan, then there is no doubt that the reasonable cost of the trip must be added to those factors, and the cost of the trip to Kazakhstan is divided as follows: The prices of flight tickets to Kazakhstan are controlled by several factors, including the travel season, airline policy, or the proximity and distance of the place from which you will depart, but in general the cost of a round-trip flight starts from $300 in the Gulf countries, while it is relatively lower for flights originating from Türkiye or Europe. As for the cost ofvisa It is good that Kazakhstan has granted citizens of some countries entry without a visa, such as Türkiye, the Emirates, and Saudi Arabia. For more information about the Kazakhstan visa, you can visit the website Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Kazakhstan. Transportation in Kazakhstan is plentiful, making it a great opportunity for those who want family tourism in Kazakhstan, as transportation on buses costs less than half a dollar, while taxis do not exceed $2 per trip. There are also domestic flights, but they are relatively expensive, as the price of the trip starts from $50, while train trips are considered economical options, as they do not exceed $20 for long distances. There is no doubt that staying in the capital of Kazakhstan"Almaty“It is considered one of the best options for travelers who want to enjoy the local atmosphere, but at the same time its cost is the highest, but we can find here varying prices for accommodation starting from $7 for youth hostels, or $20 for medium-sized hotels, while exceeding $80 for luxury hotels. Food prices in Kazakhstan do not differ from Gulf countries such as Saudi Arabia, where the prices of food items in grocery stores are very low, so preparing your meal yourself will not cost you a large sum. For example, the price of a kilo of chilled meat starts at $8, while the price of a liter of milk will not exceed 80 cents.  But on the other hand, eating in restaurants costs you a relatively higher value, as it starts from $5 in local restaurants, and may exceed $20 in luxury restaurants, and the most famous restaurants there are: Gosti Restaurant, Alasha Restaurant, and El Mirador Restaurant. Visiting tourist attractions does not require a large cost, as a full tour throughout the day will cost you between 20 and 50 dollars, while the entrance fee to Lake Kolsai or the Altai Mountains is between 2 and 5 dollars maximum. If your trip is winter, you must visit ski resorts such as Shymbulak in order to enjoy the skiing experience for the equivalent of only 20 dollars. Among the best tourist places in Kazakhstan: Markay National Park, the Caspian Sea, Aisha Bibi Village, and Shakhstan Market. Of course, we cannot ignore the cost of shopping and buying souvenirs, as there are many malls and local markets where you can find valuable gifts, including clothes and shoes whose prices start from $60, and you can also find lower prices during sales seasons.  The summer and winter months are peak tourism season in Kazakhstan, so if you want to travel during that time you should book your trip well in advance to get a reasonable price.
But if you are looking for greater cost savings, I advise you to travel in the spring or fall, as prices are lower  Hotels have noticeably increased, and tourism companies are working to attract tourists at this time with great discounts.
